name: Watermelon, green apple, and lime salad
intro: This is delicious as it is—it screams summer, it screams virtuous and it denitely

ingredients.item: medium watermelon (2¾ lb/1.3kg), rind and seeds discarded and
flesh cut into 2¾-inch/7cm-long, ¼-inch/½ cm-wide batons (4¾ cups/600g)
Granny Smith apples, cored and cut into 2¾-inch/7cm-long, ¼-inch/
limes: finely zest to get 2 tsp, then juice to get 3 tbsp
lemongrass stalk, trimmed, woody outer leaves discarded, then finely chopped (2 tbsp)
cup/10g cilantro leaves flaked sea salt

method: Mix the salad just before you’re ready to serve, otherwise it will get too soggy. In a large bowl, combine the watermelon, apples, lime zest, lime juice, olive oil, and lemongrass with three-quarters of the herbs and ¾ tsp of flaked salt. Using your hands as a natural sieve, arrange the salad on a platter. There will be quite a bit of juice at the bottom of the bowl; you don’t need it. Scatter with the remaining herbs, sprinkle with the mustard seeds and ¼ tsp of flaked salt, and serve.
